newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-DUGARRY IN FRANCE SQUAD FOR FRIENDLY IN PORTUGAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUGARRY IN FRANCE SQUAD FOR FRIENDLY IN PORTUGAL.

text.p: AC Milan striker Christophe Dugarry won his first international call since injury in the Euro 96 quarter-finals in June when he was named on Tuesday in France's 18-man squad for a friendly away to Portugal next week.

Monaco defender Patrick Blondeau and Bordeaux's France under-21 midfielder Ibrahima Ba, who has been courted by Barcelona, were called up to the full national squad for the first time. The match takes place in Braga on January 22.
Goalkeepers - Fabien Barthez (Monaco), Christophe Revault (Le Havre)
Defenders - Laurent Blanc (Barcelona), Patrick Blondeau (Monaco), Vincent Candela (Guingamp), Marcel Desailly (AC Milan), Bruno N'Gotty (Paris St Germain), Lilian Thuram (Parma)
Midfielders - Ibrahima Ba (Bordeaux), Didier Deschamps, Zinedine Zidane (both Juventus), Christian Karembeu, Pierre L'Aigle (both Sampdoria)
Forwards - Youri Djorkaeff (Inter Milan), Christophe Dugarry (AC Milan), Franck Gava (Lyon), Patrice Loko (Paris St Germain), Robert Pires (Metz).
